entries.6883b07b3bc3f2c6: It sets out as its management philosophy “Professional hospitality that is seared into the heart, producing occasions where people gather,” and aims to become “the world's finest hospitality company.” It sets out as its basic policies: opening guest houses centered on the Tokyo metropolitan, Kansai and Chukyo areas; developing competitive, high value-added products; improving proposal and sales capabilities to meet diverse customer needs; rationalizing management and improving operational efficiency; and raising funds with emphasis on cost of capital. On the other hand, property, plant and equipment was ¥43,036 million in Japan, ¥45,779 million in the United States and ¥612 million in Southeast Asia, and due to the acquisition of hotel facilities in the United States, assets located in the United States exceeded those in Japan.
